verdict.rationale: Calendly runs a public pricing page that lists what tiers include. It documents a Free tier ('Always free... One-on-one scheduling; Customizable booking page') and paid features such as round-robin, Stripe/PayPal and recordings. A community user cites a published per-user price of $16/$20 per user per month for the Teams plan, and only on that tier for round-robin. However, the first-party evidence shows no actual price figures or a per-seat breakdown by tier. missing for 10: first-party per-seat price figures for each tier, a complete tier-by-tier inclusion comparison, clarity on whether top tiers require contacting sales.
